title: Spatial Navigator R04 recovery
human_intent: Recover Spatial Navigator V50/V53 lineage, Exact Back and Human Accepted physics from durable evidence; preserve version-specific capabilities and regressions without redesigning accepted behavior or promoting authority pointers.
already_decided: V23 exact SHA f15f67240794b9d3224cc11f1899819485c08554b517b48ea6fca8458eb41398 is the Human Accepted folder-stack physics oracle and rollback donor, not the visible frontend current.
navigator/index.html blob 7ca5f3e223ca843e3f9e4b7be1e53b5b65dd3418 is the V53 visible frontend base; visible direction and physics authority remain separate.
V50 SHA 85968e5ccdea0b56ac37ee77a3e1e0562c9e65c8218c11e6d2eb0b6e6605b187 is the preserved candidate-lineage base for the V53 atlas reconstruction, not a Human Accepted pointer.
Exact Back restores semantic identity before viewport coordinates; resize/orientation must never turn stale pixels into semantic state.
Navigator owns spatial camera/gesture/entry/return; pages own content and Catalog owns hierarchy/route metadata.
Do not mutate canonical V53 bytes merely to document or recover R04.
Agent Network owns coordination/network/**. R04 does not claim that subtree as material scope; its one worker-status object is only the runtime-mandated independent status write.
ref_convention: Every source reference names main, the recovery branch, or an exact commit/blob/SHA. Version labels alone never establish authority.
read_only_by_default: coordination/network/** except the runtime-mandated independent worker-status write
served release pointers and Human Accepted receipts
high_value_targets: Leave a durable lineage/regression matrix that distinguishes V23 physics, V50 lineage base, V53 visible capabilities and Served state.
Bind recovery claims to inspectable exact evidence instead of chat-only memory.
Add non-mutating regression guards for current V53 Exact Back/history/return mechanics and authority separation.
Preserve negative knowledge so future shell/capture/navigation work does not replace accepted physics with a newer-looking implementation.
known_failures: Treating highest version number as universal truth.
Interpreting V23 Human Accepted physics as a request to revert the visible frontend to V23.
Letting generic shell/material/touch systems attach globally to V53 and compete with native Navigator ownership.
Restoring parent state from stale pixel coordinates instead of semantic identity.
Creating visible regression while claiming architectural improvement.
Treating a reconstruction or candidate as authentic Human Accepted bytes.
